---

**What are you trying to do on your Steam Deck?**
Describe the goal in one or two sentences (e.g. "Move ROMs from PC to Deck without unzipping first", "Sync save files automatically every night", "See how full my SD card is before transferring").

**Describe the feature you would like**
A clear description of how you imagine it working. Include where in the app it should live: Transfer tab, Sync tab, History tab, Rebalance ROMs, Fix ROM paths, Settings, or something new.

**Which existing feature is this closest to (if any)?**
- [ ] Transfer
- [ ] Sync
- [ ] History
- [ ] Rebalance ROMs
- [ ] Fix ROM paths
- [ ] Settings / connection setup
- [ ] Storage bars in the header
- [ ] Something new

**Alternatives you have tried**
What workarounds you currently use (WinSCP, FileZilla, SteamOS scripts, EmuDeck tools, etc.) and why they fall short.

**Your setup (optional, helps reproduce)**
- Windows version:
- Connection mode: Ethernet / Wi-Fi / Direct Ethernet
- Deck Transfer version:
- Free or Pro:
- Storage in question: internal / SD card / both

**Additional context, mockups, or screenshots**
Drag-and-drop any UI mockup or screenshot. If you have a Konsole command or shell script that does what you want today, paste it here.
